narrative_spine.point: There's an anthem lyric hidden in England's collar that most fans never notice.
What is actually woven into the England and Canada kits: anthem line, Three Lions, St George's Cross; maple leaf and a 'black ice' winter pattern.

This is heraldry by another name — coats of arms, regimental colours and national dress have encoded identity into cloth for centuries; a collar quoting the anthem is the same logic run through a kit studio instead of a herald's office.
Kit-reveal season is landing now, ahead of the 2026 tournament, so the close-read decoding content is peaking.
Kit design has become a literacy test: national identity is now transmitted through close-read content, not just the badge on the chest.
